rect.title: map: Apply a Float -> Float function to each element of a Vector Float. Original symbol: SourceArray.map
÷: Fractional a => a -> a -> a. Divide the first value by the second. Original symbol: Data.Fractional./

Fractional Float: Type-class instance Fractional Float. It selects the implementation of overloaded methods. Its body stays unexpanded. Original symbol: inst$Data.Fractional.Fractional@Primitives.Float
sum: Vector Float -> Float. Add elements from left to right, starting at zero. Original symbol: SourceArray.sum
map: Apply a Float -> Float function to each element of a Vector Float. Original symbol: SourceArray.map
exp: Floating a => a -> a. Compute e raised to the given value. Original symbol: Data.Floating.exp
Floating Float: Type-class instance Floating Float. It selects the implementation of overloaded methods. Its body stays unexpanded. Original symbol: inst$Data.Floating.Floating@Primitives.Float
−: Num a => a -> a -> a. Subtract the second value from the first. Original symbol: Data.Num.-
Num Float: Type-class instance Num Float. It selects the implementation of overloaded methods. Its body stays unexpanded. Original symbol: inst$Data.Num.Num@Primitives.Float
maximum: Vector Float -> Float. Select the maximum of a nonempty vector in input order. Original symbol: SourceArray.maximum
